items.title: 68516_Gene Ramey oral history interview
items.q: It had this guy, Maranyi in it, Joe Maranyi. I went there with them.

ctx.x: I stayed with him. Then I went out and started working with Buck doing the, you know, gigs on weekends and things, and we went back to Europe. Now, this was -- by this time it was '61, and then in '62 I went with Teddy Wilson and stayed with him until I went with Earl Hines. When I left Earl Hines, I stopped over there with Eddie Condon and stayed over there until July -- September, and I quit that and took a job in the hospital for about six months, and I got the job with Chase, you know.

But in the meantime I was still playing on weekends, you know, with Buck and different groups. I even went to (The Village Streamers) Toronto with the group that made 'Fiddler on the Roof.' It had this guy, Maranyi in it, Joe Maranyi. I went there with them.
Now, the funny thing, soon as I got in the Chase Manhattan, I got a call from Louis Armstrong wanting me to come in right away.
